relationships.subject: COL1A1
relationships.evidence_quote: Collagen type I α 1 (COL1A1) binds to PDGFR-α and promotes its phosphorylation, which contributed to pain-like behaviors and muscle contraction.

relationships.subject: PDGFR-α
relationships.evidence_quote: In rats, PDGFR-α activation caused pain-like behaviors and muscle contraction via the Janus kinase 2/signal transducer and activator of transcription-3 (JAK2/STAT3) pathway.

relationships.subject: AZD1480
relationships.evidence_quote: JAK2/STAT3 inhibitors reversed the pain-like behaviors and muscle contraction induced by PDGFR-α activation.

relationships.subject: PDGFR-α
relationships.evidence_quote: the activation of PDGFR-α increased protein levels of c-fos in the L4–L5 dorsal horn of spinal cords

relationships.subject: PDGFR-α
relationships.evidence_quote: PDGFR-α activation caused pain-like behaviors and muscle contraction

key_findings: PDGFR-α phosphorylation is elevated in human MTrPs tissue and correlates with pain intensity.
COL1A1 binds PDGFR-α, promoting JAK2/STAT3 signaling, inflammation, muscle contraction and pain-like behavior in rats.
